name: BTC Long on Falling Treasury Yields
description: Long-only BTC/USD strategy that enters positions when US 10-year Treasury yields are falling (bullish for risk assets) and exits when yields start rising again. Uses 7-day rate of change on yield data to identify directional trends.
source:
# BTC Long on Falling Treasury Yields

# Market data source for BTC
src = market_data_source(timeframe=4H)()
close = src.c

# Load US 10-year Treasury yield data
obs_date, yield_value, revision = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.Treasury10Y)()

# Forward-fill yield data to align with 4H bars
yield_filled = ffill(yield_value)

# Calculate 7-day rate of change on yield (7 days = 42 4H bars)
yield_roc = roc(period=42)(yield_filled)

# Entry: yield ROC is negative (yields falling)
long_entry = yield_roc < 0

# Exit: yield ROC turns positive (yields rising)
long_exit = yield_roc >= 0

# Hold position using entry/exit signals
held_long = hold_until()(enter=long_entry, exit=long_exit)

# Execute long positions
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long)

# Position sizing: 100% equity when signal is active
position_size(type="percent")(size=100 if held_long else 0)
